boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: Earth, weakened by the Earth Corps' economic sanctions.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: Some years after the death of Tatsunoshin, leader of the Resistance that fought back...

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: his son Chiyomaru went to see Tessan, genius strategist and his father's right hand.

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: ...Come as often as you like, my answer is the same. My only lord was Tatsunoshin.

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Only son or not, I will not serve a second master!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ...You are a coward!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: ! What!?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: With such talent, you'd play the hermit instead of helping the people!?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: I do not ask it for my sake.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Rise again for all the people suffering under the Earth Corps' tyranny!!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Don't lecture me, boy! If you preach a great cause, then show me your resolve!!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Splendidly done...!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Tessan...!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Say no more! For now, my life is yours, Lord Chiyomaru.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ...Thank you.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ...That is our deployment. Let no one drop their guard! All hands, battle stations!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Will this do, Tessan?

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Justice is on our side! Show them the might of the Resistance!

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: You... You're Tatsunoshin's son...!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Gawaine... I didn't want us to meet like this.

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: Such is the way of war. Have at you!

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: You've grown... Heh. You truly are Tatsunoshin's son.

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: Your father and I were rivals for many years... We tried to kill each other many times.

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: Falling to his son is a fine end... Be a good leader. Farewell!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Gawaine!!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: ...Bah. That man is no easy prey. I doubt he would die so easily.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: I hope you're right...

boxes.speaker: A Resistance soldier, by radio
boxes.english: "Lord Chiyomaru! The Earth Corps is falling back!"

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Don't pursue them! ...Well done, everyone.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru, thinking
boxes.english: "We drove them off for now, but the Earth Corps will regroup and strike again..."
boxes.note: Thoughts in brackets become quoted thoughts: the font has no brackets.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru, thinking
boxes.english: "When they do, can I lead the Resistance to victory...?"

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Long time no see, Chiyomaru!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Jin Saotome! What are you doing here...!?

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Good to see you again! Now, let's fight!!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Saotome... Did you sense what was troubling me...?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: I understand what you were telling me!

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Heh, I lost. Back to square one with my training.

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: See you, Chiyomaru! Let's meet again someday, somewhere out in space!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ...Thank you, Saotome. I will not falter again!

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: Damn Resistance, their lines have no gaps... Their new leader is good.

boxes.speaker: A soldier, by radio
boxes.english: "The samples are all loaded out!"

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: Good. We're done here. Blow up the facility!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: You'd take the whole city with it!?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: How could you...! Is your talk of keeping Earth's peace just for show!?

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: How naive, boy!

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: Tch, I slipped up... But I've bought enough time.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Is this... Is this how you do things!? Is THIS the world you want...!?

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: ...Mission complete. Returning to base.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ...Damn it!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: We must withdraw too. ...There is nothing left here.

boxes.speaker: A Resistance soldier
boxes.english: Tessan, sir! There's a letter on Lord Chiyomaru's desk...!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru's letter
boxes.english: "I no longer have the confidence to lead the Resistance..."

boxes.speaker: A Resistance soldier
boxes.english: Tessan, sir!!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Leave him be. As he is now, it makes no difference whether he is here or not.

boxes.speaker: Tessan, thinking
boxes.english: "He cannot serve the cause if he can't overcome this. Open your eyes, Lord Chiyomaru!"

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Ah, this is... where Father and I used to train... I've wandered so far...

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ! Who's there!?

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: You're Chiyomaru, right? Then let's have ourselves a match!!

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: Okay, okay, you win! No wonder old man Gawaine thinks so highly of you.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ! Gawaine!? He's alive!?

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: He asked me to check on you, but you're doing fine. By the way, I've got a hot tip.

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: Word is the Earth Corps has a "bio-weapon" lab in the next town. Watch yourself!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: A "bio-weapon"...!?

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: Hey, no need to thank me. The old man paid me plenty up front. See ya!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: So this is the town...

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: What does it matter... The Earth Corps, the Resistance...

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: Are you all alone too...?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ! ...Who are you?

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: I'm Arieta... That's what they call me...

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: It's dangerous to be out here alone. Do you live in this town?

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: I don't know... anything. My head... My head hurts...!!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Hey! Arieta!?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: !! Arieta!?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Did you summon a cyberbot!?

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps scientist
boxes.english: Damn it, my precious test subject...!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: A "bio-weapon"... It can't be...!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ...Arieta...!!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: I'm sorry I worried you, Tessan.

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Not at all! We stand ready, every one of us.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: All ships, launch! Target: the Earth Corps' final weapon! Justice is on our side!!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Watch me, Arieta. So your tragedy never happens again, I'll end this war here!

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: Have the Resistance sniffed out our final weapon...!?

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: Send out SHADE! Use him to hold them off!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ! Something's coming...!

boxes.speaker: Lieutenant Mary
boxes.english: SHADE is down!? They broke through so fast... Fine, I'll go myself!

boxes.speaker: A commander, by radio
boxes.english: "That's enough, Lieutenant Mary. Fall back."

boxes.speaker: Lieutenant Mary
boxes.english: Sir!?

boxes.speaker: A commander, by radio
boxes.english: "We are deploying GOD. Pull your unit back as well."

boxes.speaker: Lieutenant Mary
boxes.english: GOD!? But it isn't finished yet...

boxes.speaker: A commander, by radio
boxes.english: "You have done well. Get some rest."

boxes.speaker: A Resistance soldier, by radio
boxes.english: "Lord Chiyomaru, we've boarded the final weapon! Now we... Wh-what is that!?"

boxes.speaker: A Resistance soldier, by radio
boxes.english: "Aaaaaaaarrgh!!"

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: What happened!?

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: That must be their trump card... the final weapon's brain, from the reports.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: !! Raaaaaaahh!!

boxes.speaker: A Resistance soldier
boxes.english: Lord Chiyomaru, the final weapon is ours!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Yes! Well done, everyone!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Lord Chiyomaru!!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: The power station that fed the final weapon has left orbit and is falling!!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: If it hits the Earth... it will be a catastrophe!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: What!?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Do you have any ideals?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Might alone does not make right!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: What a waste of time that was.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: For now, I simply walk the path I believe in.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: I won't let the hopes of thousands of comrades go to waste!!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Fool!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: There is much to be done... I cannot die yet.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: You have great power. But what of your heart?

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: Heh... But no one can control the station from outside now. It can't be stopped!

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: I win.

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Even with every ship and cyberbot pushing, we cannot stop it... We are beaten.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Ugh...! ...All hands, abandon ship!!

boxes.speaker: A Resistance soldier
boxes.english: And you, Lord Chiyomaru!?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: I'll stay and steer its fall to wherever it will do the least harm...

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: I'm sorry, Tessan. There's no time to get you out...

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Too late for that. My life has been yours for a long time now!

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: It's useless. I told you, ideals can't change reality!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Even if I fall, my comrades will carry on the dream...

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Whatever happens, I believe in humanity! I believe in the human heart!!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: One minute until the hull reaches its heat limit...!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: ...Is this the end!?

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Don't give up!

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: !! What!?

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: He's right. You must not give up!

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: Tch, I had a bad feeling about this! My brand-new booster's ruined! Just my luck!!

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: Are you okay...?

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: Saotome! Gawaine! Arieta... Everyone...!!

boxes.speaker: Resistance soldiers, by radio
boxes.english: "Lord Chiyomaru! We're with you too!"

boxes.speaker: (blank box)
boxes.note: The blank box shared with the roster endings; it stays blank.

boxes.speaker: A Resistance soldier, by radio
boxes.english: "Everyone, follow meeee!!"

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: ...Im-impossible...!!

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: 2100 A.D... The Earth Corps and the Resistance signed a peace treaty.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: Chiyomaru took high office in the new government, still fighting for a world at peace.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: Mary Miyabi vanished after the war. No one knows where she went...
